title: traffic signs viewer data.json v1
description: What the skifahrer/traffic-signs viewer reads: every sign with its names and each country's image, built from `signs/` by `python3 -m viewer`. Readers ignore keys they don't know.

$schema.description: The schema the file follows: this schema's $id.

categories.description: Category folder → its label, in display order.

countries.description: Every country with at least one sign, by code, sorted.

groups.description: Groups the viewer can compare at once, in menu order.

signs.description: By category, then by folder name.

sitePath.description: An image: a path from the site root (`signs/warning/danger/sk/danger-sk.svg`), or a web rendering when browsers cannot show the file (a TIFF's Commons thumbnail).

name.description: English: `Slovakia`, `California`. The upper-case code when the country has no pipeline.

language.description: The key of the country's names in each sign's `names`: `sk`, `de-AT`, `en-US-CA`. Null without a pipeline.

region_of.description: Only for a region of a country (`us-ca`): the country (`us`).

region_label.description: What the country's regions are called: `US states`.

countries.description: The members that have signs. Empty: listed, but cannot be chosen.

members.description: How many members the group has in all.

names.description: The sign's names file (sign-names.schema.json); empty when it has none.

variant_of.description: The sign of the same category this one is a variant of.

variants.description: Its variants, in natural order (`speed-limit-5` before `speed-limit-10`).

source.description: The image's page on Wikimedia Commons.
